note: Classic NPC system, step A (Radar, Steve-approved 2026-10-21; design in items/NPC_DESIGN.md). packages: what an NPC does in a slot; 'marker' is the kind of world marker it goes to (bed, chair, post) and 'state' the body state there. schedule: 24 hourly slots of package names, read with the NPC's own jitter (+/- jitter_min). Beyond active_radius_m from every player an NPC is dormant: not simulated, placed at the marker its schedule says when a player comes in range. Tick rates by distance to the nearest player: near (hz_near within near_m), mid (hz_mid within mid_m), far (hz_far). Markers live in markers.json (x, z; the ground gives y) and admin additions in the store folder.
